_note: Floors for scripts/ci_check.py. Retrieval floors are the values measured on Windows on 2026-11-13 minus 0.01, a margin for floating-point differences between platforms that has not been measured yet; tighten it after the first Linux CI run. Recorded-run floors are the exact baseline of each recorded run, rounded down: re-grading the same replies is deterministic, so any drop means ingestion, the citation check or the grader changed what counts as a verified answer.
